integrity: The seven embedded files are complete self-contained artifacts; the finite verifier is diagnostic, not a proof of infinite theorems.
scientific_limitations: Only price-homogeneous edge classes of finite Möbius ladders; fixed-real-order asymptotics, without uniform joint-order bounds. The p=0 determinant threshold was previously published, and equivalent positive-order results may be unindexed. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Half-order price scaling for antipodal rung deletion on Möbius ladders
